sources.title: ATO: Tax reform, tax loss carry back
sources.fact: Read 26 September 2026 (page last updated 27 August 2026). States the measure is law: corporate tax entities with aggregated annual global turnover under $1 billion may carry back a revenue tax loss against tax paid in either or both of the 2 previous income years, limited by the franking account balance, for income years starting on or after 1 July 2026.
sources.limitations: ATO summary. Apply Division 160 of the ITAA 1997 as substituted, not this page.

sources.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 2) Act 2026
sources.fact: Read 26 September 2026 through the Federal Register API (C2026A00071, made 26 August 2026). Schedule 1 substitutes Division 160 of the ITAA 1997, the corporate loss carry back tax offset for businesses that are not significant global entities. Schedule 2 covers the $20,000 instant asset write-off.
sources.limitations: As-made text. Read the application provisions and the ITAA 1997 compilation for the period.
